description: Validate a Mexican RFC offline: format (moral 12 / física 13 characters), the YYMMDD date part, the homoclave check digit and the generic RFCs, plus a cross-check against the SAT 69-B list. Does not prove the RFC is registered with the SAT. Not an official SAT service. Free: 20 calls per client per UTC day, shared by the Mexico tools (mx_sat_69b_lookup, mx_rfc_validate). When the free quota is used up the tool returns an error naming the paid HTTP endpoint https://mx.redtapeapi.com/v1/mx/rfc/validate ($0.002 USDC per successful call over x402 on Base, no account or API key).
name: mx_rfc_validate
title: Validate a Mexican RFC (offline) + SAT 69-B cross-check
